description: This file defines interfaces and includes dependencies for the 'reftable' data structure, including functions for table initialization, iteration, and block reading.

methods.name: reftable_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the given reftable table.

methods.name: table_init_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over the given table with a specified type.

methods.name: table_init_block
methods.description: Initializes a block by reading from the specified table and offset, with desired type.
